name: MonovaryOn.sum_smul_comp_perm_le_sum_smul
statement: MonovaryOn f g s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ s) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g (σ i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i

name: MonovaryOn.sum_smul_comp_perm_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement: MonovaryOn f g s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ s) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g (σ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i ↔ MonovaryOn f (g ∘ σ) s

name: MonovaryOn.sum_comp_perm_smul_eq_sum_smul_iff
statement: MonovaryOn f g s) (hσ : {x | σ x ≠ x} ⊆ s) : ∑ i ∈ s, f (σ i) • g i = ∑ i ∈ s, f i • g i ↔ MonovaryOn (f ∘ σ) g s
